protocol_name: MRTA Three-Solver Unified Fair Experiment Protocol
project_model: dual-rail four-cantilever-robot welding; fixed y=6 m split; optimized upper/lower x cuts; split cross-boundary welds; open routes; exact two-state direction decoding

rationale.seed_policy: Thirty deterministic solver seeds (42-71) are recommended. Thirty paired repetitions per frozen instance support stable distribution summaries and paired non-parametric comparisons while keeping every solver on identical seeds.
rationale.budget_policy: The primary budget is the number of complete four-robot system candidate evaluations. Every solver now exposes a non-invasive maximum and reports the realized count. Wall-clock is only a safety timeout.
rationale.reference_policy: Official comparisons use a theoretical ideal point and one deterministic, solver-independent baseline range per frozen instance. Legacy ratio references are historical compatibility only.
rationale.approval_policy: The w30 common-budget pilot has passed; formal execution remains fail-closed until the user explicitly approves the protocol.
rationale.normalization_policy: Raw makespan, load imbalance, and idle distance remain primary. Normalized components are unbounded above and use no clipping.

known_limitations: The deterministic baseline is a common heuristic anchor, not an optimum or nadir point.
The 0.05*C_ideal load-imbalance floor is a pre-fixed numerical-stability convention, not an industrial standard.
Weight, baseline-construction, and load-floor sensitivity analyses are required before drawing robust scientific conclusions.
Results produced with legacy_ratio_refs_v1 are not numerically comparable with ideal_baseline_range_v1 and are excluded from official summaries.
Equal complete-system objective-evaluation counts equalize outer scientific observations, not CPU instructions or internal neighborhood checks.
W30 supports the calibrated common budget and timeout, but w45/w60 timing remains uncalibrated and formal execution still requires explicit user approval.
Protocol 2.6 freezes scale-calibration rules before execution; calibrated values live in separately hashed stage outputs.
Collision audit is a deterministic postprocess Pilot and is not part of solver fitness or ranking.
Formal budget and timeout options require an explicit user choice; formal execution remains fail-closed.

budget.w45_w60_timeout_status: uncalibrated; independent scale pilots remain required

collision_audit.timing_policy: collision_audit_time is separate from algorithm_time and solver_wall_clock_time
collision_audit.raw_metric_policy: raw fitness, makespan, boundaries, routes, and directions remain byte-for-byte unchanged
collision_audit.failure_policy: write an explicit failed audit record and never claim collision success
collision_audit.output_policy: write collision_postprocess.json separately; never overwrite result.json or unified_metrics.json

output_schema.runner_validation: independent frozen-instance split, route-ID/direction reconstruction, and public motion-model recomputation; mismatch marks run invalid

outputs.missing_metric_policy: mark invalid; never impute for protocol validation or formal summaries
outputs.retry_policy: never overwrite; create the next attempt_NNN directory after preserving and classifying the prior attempt
outputs.cross_mode_comparison_policy: exclude; never merge legacy and official normalization modes

statistics.unit: paired solver seed within each frozen instance
statistics.success_definition: successful exact-budget raw run with valid independent reconstruction
statistics.omnibus_test: Friedman test per instance on raw fitness across the three paired solvers
statistics.pairwise_test: two-sided paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test for all three solver pairs per instance
statistics.multiplicity: Holm correction within the three pairwise tests of each instance
statistics.effect_size: rank-biserial correlation for paired Wilcoxon comparisons
statistics.win_tie_loss: per-seed raw-fitness W/T/L with absolute tie tolerance 1e-12
statistics.confidence_interval: paired median difference percentile bootstrap, 10000 resamples, deterministic seed 20260715, 95% CI
statistics.missing_failure_policy: report success rate; inferential tests use only complete paired successful seeds and disclose paired count
statistics.ranking_policy: no ranking from calibration or collision-audit Pilot data

historical_pilot_evidence.user_override: After GA+ACO completed 16000 evaluations, DE-LKH was stopped and HGA/ABMA were run at a reduced 5000-evaluation budget.

scale_calibration.calibration_results_location: external stage outputs; protocol is immutable before execution

budget_options.A: one global budget: minimum validated instance budget, rounded down to 1000
budget_options.B: validated per-instance budgets shared by all three solvers within each instance

timeout_options.global: maximum of all per-instance timeout recommendations

formal_experiment_design.resume_policy: skip only a successful run with matching protocol, scientific-source, and command hashes
formal_experiment_design.failure_policy: retain failed/timeout attempt; never silently substitute or include it in success statistics
formal_experiment_design.collision_policy: audit frozen successful raw results as a separate postprocess; report raw and adjusted metrics separately

dimensions.objective_weights: one-at-a-time alternatives around [0.7,0.2,0.1], renormalized to sum one
dimensions.load_scale_floor: predeclared positive floors without changing the frozen main normalization
dimensions.baseline_construction: alternative deterministic baseline constructors in isolated protocol snapshots
dimensions.collision_separation: raw optimization and collision postprocess remain distinct metric families
